title: Paul McCartney live: Georgia Dome, Atlanta | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Georgia Dome in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, on 1 May 1993.

It was the 22nd night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993. The show was seen by 46,352 fans.

The performance of ‘Lady Madonna’ from this show appears on the 1993 live album Paul Is Live.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.
